items.item_text: Background Check: Continued employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory background investigation.
Live Scan Background Check: A Live Scan background check must be completed prior to the start of employment.
Age Requirement: Candidate(s) must be 18 years or older to be eligible to be hired.
Evening, weekend, and holiday work as business dictates (Required)
Bachelor's Degree in a related field (Required) Or
2+ years Experience in personnel, accounting, project management, or administration in a department of two hundred or more employees

Experience maintaining a high standard of productivity within a broad scope of responsibility despite frequent interruptions; Ability to complete a large volume of diverse tasks efficiently, meeting established deadlines

The UCLA Luskin Conference Center is seeking a dynamic, highly organized Executive Office Coordinator to drive seamless operational and administrative leadership within our world-class hospitality environment. Situated at the heart of the UCLA campus, the Luskin Conference Center bridges academic excellence with top-tier lodging and event management. As the primary administrative anchor for the executive team, you will manage high-level scheduling, facilitate cross-departmental communications, oversee daily office logistics, and support VIP guest relations. This role requires a polished professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, balances competing priorities with ease, and embodies UCLA Hospitality's commitment to exceptional customer service.

Skill organizing information, people, finances and other resources to develop effective programs and bring to closure projects simultaneously while optimizing efficiency and minimizing duplication of effort
Working knowledge of University policies, procedures, and business systems
Skill in analyzing operating procedures and recommending necessary changes consistent with accepted practices
Highly developed interpersonal communication skills including political acumen and social perceptiveness
Expert skill using standard business software (e.g. Microsoft Office Suite)

Excellent oral and written communication skills to effectively communicate with diverse populations with competing priorities; Ability to effectively and clearly convey information to individuals at various organization levels and to groups of different sizes
Skill in writing grammatically correct business English, such as proposals, memos, and other routine correspondence
Ability to encourage and motivate individuals to work together to achieve department's goals and objectives
Skill in working as part of a team and collaborating with colleagues, and ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with administrators, faculty, students and staff
Demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential matters discreetly and maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive information
